visual: Use case: style-transfer. Create a production background for a fantasy game Hall of Fame. FIRST REFERENCE is exact structural layout; SECOND REFERENCE supplies theme materials and palette. ROYAL: dark warm stone castle, navy blue fabric banners, gold borders, amber torch lighting. Ornate but rounded believable stone and metal, regal welcoming heroic atmosphere. Preserve FIRST image camera, 16:9 aspect ratio and EXACT layout of seven EMPTY round pedestals: one central back pedestal with its top centered at 50% x,37.1% y; side pairs at (31.3%,48.4%),(68.8%,48.4%),(22.4%,60%),(77.7%,60%),(13.3%,75.7%),(86.2%,75.7%). Preserve each platform's scale and ellipse perspective, central walkway, and full visible foreground bases. These coordinates are required for a live interface overlay. Restyle the architecture, floor, platform ornament and textiles according to second reference. Seven pedestals only. Their tops have subtle inlaid circles but NO bright beams, flares or baked-in magical light; glow will be animated separately. Keep clear empty air above all platforms for portraits to be composited later. Beautiful polished dimensional hand-painted fantasy game art, clear depth, carefully drawn gold metal, natural stone and fabric. NO characters, creatures, orbs, avatars, text, letters, labels, UI, watermark or extra platforms. Wide landscape 16:9. Do not turn all surfaces into crystals.
